Name: Sam as Tom lucitor from star vs the forces of evil
Author: minukax
Description:
[size=6]Sam as Tom Lucitor
[/size]
I love stardew valley and also lots of cartoons, i was disappointed when i watched the end of Star vs the forces of evil. So i decided to create this mod to be with my husbando Tom Lucitor!!

[size=5]What this mod contains:
[/size]
A replacement of all the sprites of Sam to look just like Tom Lucitor from Star vs the forces of evil

[size=5]What do you need for this mod to work:[/size]

[size=2]For this mod it is necessary to have Content patcher and Smapi mods. 
You just have to Unzip the folder into your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder.

[/size][size=5]From the creator:
[/size]
I want to update this mod and also keep doing mods like this one so everyone can have their favorites characters in the game. But because i´m studying 3d character animation by the time, i wont have that much time. But if you have any request from a cartoon series and a character that you would love to change let me know in the comments.
